blocks.text: Five-kingdom system mein yeh domain kingdom Monera mein shamil tha. Archaea ka naam Greek lafz archaios se aaya hai, jis ka matlab hai “purana” (ancient). Yeh prokaryotes hain jo bohat purane zamane mein bacteria se alag ho gaye thay. Ek archaean ka diameter 0.1 μm se le kar 15 μm se zyada tak hota hai. Kuch archaea mil kar guchhe (aggregates) ya dhaage (filaments) banate hain jo 200 μm tak lambe hote hain. In ki shaklein mukhtalif hain: gol (spherical), chhari jaisi (rod-shape), spiral, lobed ya rectangular (chaukor lamba). Archaea asexual tareeqe se reproduce karte hain: binary ya multiple fission (cell ka do ya zyada hisson mein batna), fragmentation (tukron mein batna) ya budding (kali nikalna). Archaea mein mitosis aur meiosis nahi hote.
Shuru mein archaea ko bacteria ka hi ek group samjha jata tha aur inhein archaebacteria kaha jata tha.

Archaea ki cell membrane ke lipids mein glycerol aur fatty acid chains ke darmiyan ether linkage (ether jor) hota hai. Fatty acid chains branched (shaakhon wali) hoti hain. Isi wajah se in ki cell membranes sakht halaat (extreme conditions), jaise bohat garmi, namak ya tezaab, mein zyada mazboot rehti hain.

blocks.alt: Do membrane lipid molecules saath saath. Baayein taraf archaeal lipid: glycerol head jis par phosphate group laga hai, aur do branched hydrocarbon chains jo ether linkage se juri hain. Daayein taraf bacterial ya eukaryotic lipid: wahi glycerol aur phosphate head, lekin do seedhi unbranched chains jo ester linkage se juri hain.
blocks.caption: Archaea ke membrane lipids ka Bacteria aur Eukarya se muqabla (Figure 1.2 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Dono lipids mein glycerol ki buniyad (backbone) hai jis par phosphate group laga hai. Archaeal lipid mein har chain ether linkage (carbon-oxygen-carbon) se juri hai aur chains par baqaida side branches hain. Bacterial aur eukaryotic lipid mein har chain ester linkage (carbon-oxygen-carbonyl) se juri hai aur chains seedhi hain.

fallback.text: Archaeal lipid: ether linkage, branched chains. Bacterial aur eukaryotic lipid: ester linkage, unbranched chains.

blocks.text: Doosri taraf bacteria aur Eukarya ke membrane lipids mein fatty acids glycerol se ester linkage (ester jor) ke zariye jure hote hain, aur fatty acid chains unbranched (seedhi) hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Do khanon wali drawing. Oopar Archaea ka membrane lipid: do shaakhdar (branched) chains ether linkage (C-O-) se glycerol se juri hain, aur glycerol ke oopar wale carbon par phosphate group hai. Neeche Bacteria aur Eukarya ka membrane lipid: do seedhi (unbranched) chains ester linkage (C=O aur O) se glycerol se juri hain, aur glycerol par phosphate group hai.

blocks.text: Archaea ki cell walls mein cellulose aur peptidoglycan nahi hote. In ki jagah in mein alag qisam ke polysaccharides aur proteins hote hain. Kuch archaea mein pseudopeptidoglycan hota hai.

Doosri taraf bacteria ki cell walls mein peptidoglycan hota hai. Yeh sugars aur amino acids se bana ek polymer hai jo cell ko structural support (sahara) deta hai. Eukarya mein agar cell wall ho to woh plants mein cellulose ki aur fungi mein chitin ki bani hoti hai.

Archaea ki kai genetic sequences aur regulatory features (genes ko control karne wali khasoosiyat) eukaryotes jaisi hain. Is se pata chalta hai ke evolution mein archaea eukaryotes ke zyada qareeb hain.

blocks.title: Archaea ki ahmiyat
blocks.text: Jo archaea bohat zyada acidity (tezaabiyat) aur alkalinity mein rehte hain, un se aise enzymes milte hain jo sakht halaat mein bhi kaam karte hain. Maslan DNA replication ke enzymes aise archaea se nikale gaye hain. Yeh enzymes zyada temperature par sab se achha kaam karte hain aur laboratory mein DNA ki tez cloning (nakal banana) mumkin banate hain. Isi tarah methanogen archaea sewage treatment (gande paani ki safai) ka aham hissa hain: yeh anaerobic digestion (oxygen ke baghair tor phor) kar ke biogas banate hain. Acidophilic (tezaab pasand) archaea ko mineral processing mein ores (kachi dhaat) se sona (gold), cobalt aur copper nikalne ke liye istemal kiya jata hai.
Archaea mein kuch khaas metabolic processes hote hain, jaise methanogenesis, yani methane gas banana. Yeh process na bacteria mein hota hai na Eukarya mein.

Doosri taraf bacteria mein photosynthesis, nitrogen fixation aur fermentation jaise metabolic raaste (pathways) hote hain. Eukarya mein metabolism aksar zyada complex hota hai; is mein cellular respiration, photosynthesis (plants aur algae mein) aur kai qisam ki fermentation shamil hain.

Archaea ke bare groups yeh hain: Methanogens (metabolism ke by-product ke taur par methane banate hain), Halobacteria (bohat namkeen yani saline jagahon mein rehte hain), Thermococci (garam jagahon mein milte hain) aur Thaumarchaeota (nitrogen cycle mein hissa lete hain).
Insaan ki aanton (intestine) mein banne wali gas ka bara hissa methanogens ke metabolism ka nateeja hai.

blocks.alt: Ek qataar mein chaar flat tasveerein: Methanogens, bhoore (brown) background par hare rod jaise cells; Halobacteria, gehre neele par bare neele gol-sire wale rods; Thermoplasmata, grey par ek grey be-tarteeb (irregular) lobes wala cell aur chhoti scale line; Thermococci, peeli-hari background par ek gehra hara gol cell jis ke gird halka ghera hai.
